title: Texas Instruments second-quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Revenue increased 13% sequentially and 23% year over year, with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.
summary: The SEC-hosted results-release hash is unchanged. Texas Instruments reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of USD 5.463 billion, operating profit of USD 2.310 billion, diluted EPS of USD 2.14, 26% Analog growth, 16% Embedded Processing growth and third-quarter guidance of USD 5.65-6.15 billion revenue and USD 2.23-2.57 EPS.
